verdict.rationale: Mercury documents both debit and credit cards on accounts and business credit cards from day one. It also describes controlling team expenses with cards, limits and approvals, backed by granular user permissions, which implies issuing cards to employees under defined roles. However, the evidence never explicitly mentions physical cards: issuance evidence covers virtual cards only, via the UI and Cards API. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of physical card issuance, documented employee/cardholder role definitions tied to card issuance, independent corroboration of issuing cards to team members.
